Header: Macrophomina phaseolina Ulundhthil Root Alugal / உளுந்துரூட்அழுகல்நோய்

Prevention: The disease occurs commonly at the podding stage.
Monitoring: Observe damage in the seeds as the disease shows its first symptom before sowing.
Standing crop (5-10 days) turn yellow in colour and brown irregular lesions appear on leaves.
The roots and basal portion of the stem become black in colour and the bark peels off easily.
After 10 days of standing crop, the affected plants will dry up gradually.
When the tap root of the affected plant is split open, reddening of internal tissues is visible.
Direct Control: Apply zinc sulphate 25 kg/Ha as basal application.
Basal application of neem cake at 150 kg/ Ha.
T. viride at 2.5 kg/Ha + 50 kg of farm yard manure at 30 days after sowing.
Restrictions: When using a pesticide or botanical, always wear protective clothing and follow the instructions on the product label, such as dosage, timing of application, pre-harvest interval, max number of sprays, restricted re-entry interval.
Do not empty into drains and water sources.
U (Unlikely to present acute hazard in normal use).
